usedFor: Bookings in Trafft, like “Appointment Booked”, become leads in Sangam CRM through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “Appointment Booked” in Trafft, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A booking turns into a lead that Sangam CRM finds by ID, email or phone and updates if it exists.

watchOut: “Appointment Rescheduled” and “Appointment Canceled” also fire, and “Create Opportunity” would add another opportunity each time.
